ops_start_v1.text: Dusty, Dustoff Three-One, Hatay Ops. Kestrel has one urgent surgical. Cleared in.
ops_start_v1.speaker: ops_walsh

kestrel_casualty_v1.text: [whispers] Dustoff, Kestrel Two-Two. One urgent surgical. LZ is the field below us.
kestrel_casualty_v1.speaker: kestrel_ferris

kestrel_technicals_v1.text: Dusty, Kestrel. Technicals on the canal road, northbound toward the LZ.
kestrel_technicals_v1.speaker: kestrel_ferris

dusty_tally_v1.text: Kestrel, Dusty. Tally the road. Pushing ahead to engage.
dusty_tally_v1.speaker: dusty_brennan

ops_strike_v1.text: Venom One-One, Hatay Ops. Compound south of the ridge. Cleared hot.
ops_strike_v1.speaker: ops_walsh

venom_bombs_v1.text: Venom One-One, bombs away. Thirty seconds.
venom_bombs_v1.speaker: venom_lindqvist

dusty_lz_cold_v1.text: Dustoff, Dusty. LZ is cold. Come in from the west.
dusty_lz_cold_v1.speaker: dusty_brennan

dustoff_inbound_v1.text: Dusty, Dustoff. Inbound from the west. Short final in one minute.
dustoff_inbound_v1.speaker: dustoff_whitfield

kestrel_lz_hot_v1.text: [urgent] Dusty, Kestrel. Movement in the treeline east of the LZ.
kestrel_lz_hot_v1.speaker: kestrel_ferris

dustoff_lifting_v1.text: Dustoff Three-One lifting. One urgent surgical aboard. Egress west.
dustoff_lifting_v1.speaker: dustoff_whitfield

kestrel_egress_gun_v1.text: [urgent] Dusty, Kestrel. Gun truck moving south of Dustoff's egress.
kestrel_egress_gun_v1.speaker: kestrel_ferris

ops_clear_v1.text: Dustoff, Hatay Ops. Copy clear of the valley. Surgical team is waiting.
ops_clear_v1.speaker: ops_walsh
